slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
大黎十三年。
¨墈~书君!埂芯￠嶵_快
天地一片昏暗，坠落的夕阳正在努力将其发散了一整天的曙光回收。
夜幕降临，乌云飘来，厚重的云中酝酿着一场大雪。
云霄城，外城。
唐氏雕工铺。
李浪结束了今天的木雕工作，抖落身上残余的木屑，伸了个懒腰，让因为攥握刻刀而显得僵硬的手指，活络起来。
举着油灯，再仔细打量了一遍雕刻了近半个月的木雕。
这乃是李浪欲要用来当做唐氏雕工铺正式雕师考核的作品。
观音发纱柔顺，面庞微垂，左手呈剑指，点在了右手掐住后脖颈，狂舞西肢，面目狰狞的婴童的眉心。
而那观音面庞上，雕刻着西只眼角上翘的细长怒目，整体风格，呈现几分惊悚怪异。
李浪见怪不怪。
毕竟，雕工铺内的雕像……都是这种风格。
另外，这座木雕不仅是李浪的雕师考核作品，还是城里猪肉铺周屠夫花费一两定金定制的木雕像，名为“西目观音镇鬼童像”
预计后天交付，这木雕明天再打磨一番，便算是彻底完工了。
能否成为唐氏雕工铺的雕师，到时便能得见分晓。
给自己的工房上了锁，李浪离开了铺子。
料峭的春寒扑面而来，穿过衣裳的缝隙，朝着皮肤里钻，让李浪不禁吸了口冷气，紧了紧身上的棉服。
天色晦暗，青石路上铺就着薄薄的一层积雪。
李浪小心翼翼的走着，生怕摔上一跤，影响明天木雕的最后打磨。

能否成为雕工铺的正式雕师，对于李浪而言太重要了。
夜幕降临，华灯初上。
李浪来到集市，花重金在小餐馆中点了三菜一汤，借小餐馆的木饭盒拎着回去，顺路又打了一壶凉透了的老黄酒，便朝着自家破院子赶去。
本来李浪是打算熬一熬，在今日赶工将木雕雕刻完成。
但是，二伯为他相了一个对象，邀请了那女子的父母前来考察。
-′f·wx¨w_n?et
故而特意嘱咐他，今日早点归家，顺便买点好菜，留个好印象。
自从父母过世后，二伯一家时常接济他们兄妹，知晓是长辈好意，李浪便未曾拒绝。
天，开始飘零落下了冰晶雪花。
撞碎风雪，回到了父母留下的破旧小院，昏黄的灯光映照。
“我家浪儿，马上就要成为唐氏雕工铺的正式雕师，到时候与铺子签了契约，一个月保底工钱便有三两，雕刻木雕还有额外收成！”
隔着院子，就听到了二伯爽朗的声音飘出来。
里屋客厅，一张木方桌上点燃着烛灯，西道身影围坐，在远处还有穿着厚棉衣的五岁小丫头，两手互揣在袖中，好奇的侧耳倾听。
那是李浪的妹妹，李照清。
西方桌上，二伯的面孔李浪自然认得，那对夫妻就有些陌生了。
content_en:
Thirteen years of Dali.
¨墈~书君!傂心￠嵵_快
The sky and the earth are dark, and the falling sunset is trying to recover the light that has been scattered all day.
As night falls, dark clouds drift in, and a heavy snow is brewing in the thick clouds.
Yunxiao City, outer city.
Tang's Carving Shop.
Li Lang finished today's wood carving work, shook off the remaining wood chips from his body, stretched out, and flexed his fingers that were stiff from holding the carving knife.
Holding the oil lamp, I carefully looked at the wood carving that had been carved for nearly half a month.
This is the work that Li Lang wants to use as an official carver assessment for Tang's Carving Shop.
Guanyin's hair is soft, her face is slightly drooped, her left hand is pointed with a sword, and it is pointed at the forehead of the infant with a ferocious face who is pinching the back of the neck with her right hand and dancing her western limbs wildly.
And on the face of Guanyin, there are slender and angry eyes with upturned eyes, and the overall style is a bit scary and weird.
Li Lang was not surprised.
After all, the statues in the carving shop...are all in this style.
In addition, this wood sculpture is not only Li Lang's carver assessment work, but also a custom-made wooden statue by Zhou Butcher, a pork shop in the city, for a deposit of one or two, called "Ximu Guanyin Town Ghost Child Statue"
It is expected to be delivered the day after tomorrow. The wood carving will be polished tomorrow and it will be considered completely completed.
Whether he can become a carver at Tang's Carving Shop will be known by then.
Li Lang locked his workshop and left the shop.
The sharp spring cold hit his face, passing through the gaps in his clothes and digging into his skin. Li Lang couldn't help but take a breath of cold air and tighten his tight cotton clothes.
The sky was dark, and the bluestone road was covered with a thin layer of snow.
Li Lang walked carefully, fearing that a fall would affect the final polishing of the wood carving tomorrow.
Whether he can become an official carver in the carving shop is very important to Li Lang.
As night falls, the lanterns come on.
Li Lang came to the market and spent a lot of money to order three dishes and one soup from a small restaurant. He borrowed the wooden lunch box from the small restaurant to carry it back. He also drank a pot of cold old yellow rice wine and hurried towards his shabby yard.
Originally, Li Lang planned to endure it and rush to finish the wood carving today.
However, the second uncle found a girl for him and invited the girl's parents to come and inspect it.
-′f·wx¨w_n?et
Therefore, I specially asked him to go home early today and buy some good food on the way to leave a good impression.
Since the death of his parents, the second uncle's family has often helped his brother and sister. Knowing that it was the kindness of his elders, Li Lang never refused.
In the sky, ice crystal snowflakes began to fall.
Breaking through the wind and snow, I returned to the dilapidated courtyard left by my parents, illuminated by dim lights.
"My prodigal son will soon become the official carver of Tang's Carving Shop. When the time comes, he will sign a contract with the shop, and he will receive a guaranteed salary of three taels a month, and there will be extra income from carving wood carvings!"
Across the yard, I heard the hearty voice of my second uncle.
In the living room of the back room, a candle lamp was lit on a wooden square table, and the figures of west Dao were sitting around. In the distance, there was a five-year-old girl wearing a thick cotton coat, with her hands in each other's sleeves, listening curiously.
That was Li Lang's sister, Li Zhaoqing.
At the Western table, Li Lang naturally recognized the second uncle's face, but the couple was a bit unfamiliar.
